lines.2: Fukahire was trying his hardest to make the class idol his girlfriend.
lines.4: 「Until now, all I ever thought about was lame stuff like how I could brag to everyone if I made her my girlfriend. But that's not it!」
lines.5: 「I fell in love with her for real! I love her--I love her with all my heart--and that's why I'm going to confess!」
lines.7: 「You can do it. You're serious about her, so I'm sure your feelings will get through.」
lines.8: 「All right! I'll go for it, even if I crash and burn!」
lines.10: 「And that is why... I love you.」
lines.11: 「No thanks. You smell like a crawfish, Fukahire.」
lines.13: Well, that was reality for you.
lines.15: 「Why are you crying...? Ew. That's disgusting...」
lines.17: Fukahire learned how to hit women!
